description: This file defines the ContactsQuickCreate class, which extends the QuickCreate class and handles the quick creation process for contacts within the SuiteCRM application. It manages form processing, including setting up JavaScript interactions and populating dropdown options.

classes.name: ContactsQuickCreate
classes.description: A class extending QuickCreate to handle the quick creation of contact records, managing form setup, JavaScript integrations, and AJAX behavior.

methods.name: process
